## What I was trying to do

The problem in a couple of sentences. What was tedious, slow, or impossible before.

## How it works

The actual workflow. Prompts, scripts, and screenshots are all welcome. Be concrete
enough that a colleague could reproduce it.

## What worked and what did not

Honest assessment. The failures are often more useful to readers than the successes.
